pc.notes: Ember Graves is built in now too -- it sits under Tree Chopper and Better Fishing under Built-in add-ons. Die, and everything you were carrying plus ALL your XP waits in a floating ember grave instead of scattering: it hovers safely over lava, water, even the void, your XP comes back whole, and your Realm crew gets one quiet ping with the grave's coordinates so they can escort you back. Owner-only by default, and graves never despawn unless you set a lifetime. Tree Chopper v3 and Better Fishing are unchanged inside. "Check for new mods" knows all three are built in.
